scope: V16 shell dispatch, Python/Conda priority, local AI argument forwarding and legacy read-only preview
checks: V16 defaults and upload-all alias route to incremental uploader
compare forces dry-run; serve forwards to run-local
Explicit legacy advanced commands warn and preserve original arguments
No empty-command execution when Python is absent or too old
Conda and explicit interpreter paths containing spaces
Cloud/Gemini preflight and server reuse selected interpreter
AI help exits without Python, provider keys, model files or downloads
Ollama empty argument array uses Bash 3.2-compatible nounset guard
No unbraced variable immediately before non-ASCII text
Real local bare Git preview preserves refs and generated files
limits: Executed on Linux Bash 5.2; no actual macOS Bash 3.2 or Windows execution
No actual provider calls, model downloads, GitHub push or scheduled-task installation
